items.title: Positive-gamma pin band ratchets UP intraday on a frozen completed-bar frontier: across the 2026-08-04 pre-market → midday cutoffs the SPY dealer-gamma flip and BOTH walls migrate ~7-18 points higher and signed net GEX expands (+3.287B → +4.682B) while the completed daily-bar frontier stays frozen at 2026-08-03 (expectedSessionDate unchanged, 291/291 fresh, swing bars 507) AND market-heatmap breadth stays pinned at 57.53% narrow — structure migrates up without a new completed bar and without a breadth improvement.
items.note: Genuinely new versus the two prior same-window patterns on this frontier: the earlier 'frozen-frontier pre-market markdown' tracked the live BENCH repricing (price axis) and the 'coverage-expansion-on-frozen-frontier' tracked owner tools flipping to fresh reads (coverage axis). Here the novelty is on the DEALER-STRUCTURE axis: on the SAME completed-bar frontier the entire positive-gamma pin band ratchets UP — flip 743.36 → 755.68 (+12.32), call wall 758 → 765 (+7), put wall 740 → 758 (+18), expected move ±3.81 → ±4.83, signedNetGEX +3.287B → +4.682B (+1.395B) — as the live bench climbs 747.03 → 764.3 and presses the 765 call wall. Critically, market-heatmap breadthPct is UNCHANGED at 57.53% (narrow, margin -2.47) across the cutoffs, so leadership did NOT broaden even as the index ramped and the pin band lifted — a breadth/price divergence. The deterministic regime ticked slightly HIGHER (VIX 15.62 band 'VIX 15.6' → 16.25 band 'VIX 16.3', score 0 both) rather than easing, and intraday control shifted Retail-driven → Mixed while the session stayed a Trend day · up. Meanwhile dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate stays 2026-08-03 (291/291 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing) and swing bars stay 507, so the XLY rotate-into's distinct-completed-bar-date persistence stays at three dates (07-30, 07-31, 08-03) — NOT incremented — even though the rotation's out-leg rotated from XLE to XLF. Signature: dealer pin structure lifted intraday on an unchanged completed-bar frontier while breadth stayed narrow and persistence stayed put — the structure-axis complement to the earlier price-axis and coverage-axis frozen-frontier patterns.
items.method: Add a 'gamma-band-migration-on-frozen-frontier' composite test that compares two cutoffs on the SAME session frontier (dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate unchanged AND swing bar count unchanged AND freshSymbolCount==symbolCount with carriedSymbolCount==0 and missingSymbolCount==0). Assert THREE joint conditions: (1) FRONTIER FROZEN across the two cutoffs; (2) BAND MIGRATION = the dealer-gamma flip AND both walls all move in the SAME direction beyond a small tolerance across the cutoffs, and signedNetGEX changes materially in the same sense (here flip +12.32, callWall +7, putWall +18, netGEX +1.395B, all up); (3) BREADTH-STATIC GUARD = market-heatmap breadthPct (or the leadership label) is UNCHANGED across the cutoffs (here 57.53% narrow both). Emit the experimental flag only when (1) AND (2) hold, so a quiet re-read with a static band does not trip it; the additional breadth-static condition (3) marks the divergence — the dealer pin band lifted while leadership stayed narrow and no new completed bar was added (structure up, breadth flat, persistence unchanged). This is the structure-axis mirror of the price-axis 'frozen-frontier markdown' and the coverage-axis 'coverage-expansion' patterns.
